fusions.name: Mailed Swipe
fusions.desc: A gauntleted swipe that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Ironweight Crash
fusions.desc: Rears up and drops your plated weight on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Plated Hunch
fusions.desc: Hunches into your plating: a barrier absorbs the next 22 damage for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Coat of Plates
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 8% slashing resistance.
